title: 2026 UK ETS free-allocation activity-level verifier QA controls

sources.publisher: Environment Agency and UK ETS regulators
sources.title: UK Emissions Trading Scheme for installations: how to comply

facts.source_fact: UK ETS accredited verifiers verify annual activity level reports for free-allocation installations.
Verification also covers annual emissions reports.
facts.expected_handling: Keep AER and ALR scopes distinct.

facts.source_fact: Verifiers must be accredited by UKAS.
Accreditation is granted for specific scopes of verification activity.
Accreditation scope is shown on the accreditation certificate.
UKAS supervises verifiers and maintains a verifier list.
A verifier need not have a physical UK office.
The verifier assesses monitoring methods, information, data, calculations and procedures.
The verifier provides a verification opinion statement through the verification report.
Verification evidence supports installation reporting and does not create parcel measurements.
